title: Transitivity of agreement
statement: Let $K$ be a predicate on the natural numbers, and let $\mu,\mu',\mu''$ be integer-valued sequences. If $\mu'$ agrees with $\mu$ and $\mu''$ agrees with $\mu'$ at every index satisfying $K$, then $\mu''$ agrees with $\mu$ at every such index.
